question: Eight persons P, Q, R,S, T, U, V and W are sitting around a rectangular table facing the centre of the table in such a way that four of them are at the four corners of the table while the other four are sitting exactly in the middle of each side of the table. Out of these 8 persons, 3 are females who are not sitting immediately next to each other. U, who is a female, is sitting immediately next to both V and W. Q is immediately next to both S and V. R, who is a female, is sitting second to the left of Q. V, who is a male, is sitting third to the left of T, who is a female. How many persons are sitting between P and V, when counted from the left of P?
